newsitem.title: USA: Energy Search drills two successful wells.
newsitem.headline: Energy Search drills two successful wells.

text.p: Energy Search Inc said on Wednesday it sucessfully drilled two more wells at its Beaver project in southern West Virginia.

The No. 105 well encountered six commercial gas bearing sands which the company believes were all commercially productive, it said. Gas flows while drilling were measured at 189,000 cubic feet per day rate, it said.
The No. 106 well encountered four productive zones with 83 feet of net sand, the company said.
The cost to drill and complete each well was estimated at $190,000, Energy Search said.
